block_scheme.purge: shared evaluator symmetric purge plus each fit restricted to game_first_date strictly before scored game_first_date

conditioning_families.hot_night: Per-team Laplace-smoothed win rate from games with game_first_date strictly earlier than the scored game; home minus away.
conditioning_families.scheme_fit: Per-team mean first-period signed score differential, sigmoid-scaled, from games with game_first_date strictly earlier than the scored game; home minus away.
conditioning_families.planted_null: Deterministic draws from only the same earlier-game family history; the scored game and all later games are excluded.

metric: Brier and n-weighted ECE for each arm, S123 incumbent, and market on every bridged traded tick; paired game-clustered DM intervals and n_eff.
seal_canonicalization: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON serialized with sort_keys=true and separators=(comma,colon), after removing seal_sha256.
verdict_rule: Report REJECT if a planted null has positive Brier differential versus the incumbent. Otherwise report BEHIND when a real arm has nonpositive Brier differential or a paired 95 percent interval crossing zero; only report AHEAD if every real arm is beside its planted null on identical rows/folds, has at least 30 game clusters, preserves every tick with named reasons, and clears the unchanged +0.004 Brier differential bar with a positive paired interval.
